day1_results.takeaway: 9z won Aurora's Nuke pick 16-14 in OT after closing Mirage 13-11 (luchov 1.61 rating). Confirms 9z's LAN ceiling on Mirage/Nuke rather than a fluke BO1.

day1_results.outcome_type: Favorite Held (87% HotSpawn crowd on Falcons)
day1_results.takeaway: Falcons (VRS #3, 1919 pts) controlled both maps cleanly. Demonstrates why fading heavy Tier-S favorites at <25% underdog win probability burns expected points.

day1_results.outcome_type: Credible Underdog Win (25% HotSpawn crowd on Legacy)
day1_results.takeaway: Legacy (HLTV #7 / VRS #7) swept PARIVISION 2-0 despite only 25% HotSpawn crowd backing, showing how HotSpawn crowd ownership lags behind current LAN map-pool strength.

day1_results.outcome_type: Favorite Held (96% HotSpawn crowd on FURIA)
day1_results.takeaway: FURIA (VRS #2, 1958 pts) dominated Dust2 13-5 and closed Mirage 13-10. Blindly picking 4% crowd longshots against elite VRS #2 opposition is negative EV.

aurora_roster.change: kyxsan signed as in-game leader (replacing MAJ3R)

day2_results.takeaway: Aurora bounced back cleanly in 2 maps (42 total rounds) to eliminate NIP and advance to the Group A decider rematch against 9z.
9z took Mirage 13-8 off VRS #3 Falcons (luchov 2.06 map rating) and pushed both Nuke and Dust2 to 22 rounds (65 total rounds), confirming 9z's Day 1 upset was backed by real LAN form.
BetBoom reverse-swept PARIVISION after dropping Ancient 10-13, dominating Anubis 13-4 and Mirage 13-7 to reach the Group B decider against Legacy.
Legacy took Cache 13-10 off VRS #2 FURIA before FURIA closed Inferno 13-5 and Mirage 13-8, sending Legacy to the Group B decider against BetBoom.

day3_deciders.map_pool_note: HLTV 3m winrates: Aurora leads Nuke 78% (9m) vs 30% (10m), Anubis 75% (12m) vs 0m, Inferno 50% (8m) vs 25% (4m), Dust2 56% (9m) vs 43% (7m); 9z leads Mirage 67% (6m) vs 62% (16m) and won both Mirage (13-11) and Nuke (16-14 OT) in the Day 1 H2H.
day3_deciders.floor_status: Passes 30% underdog floor (33.39% >= 30.0%); sits 1.61pp below the strict 35% floor (33.39% < 35.0%). Safe/default pick: Aurora (66.61%). Aggressive leaderboard-chase swing: 9z (33.39% vs 10% crowd, 3.34x leverage).

day3_deciders.map_pool_note: HLTV 3m winrates: BetBoom leads Cache 67% (3m) vs 50% (4m) and Anubis 57% (7m, including 13-4 vs PARIVISION on Day 2) vs Legacy 0m; Legacy leads Nuke 80% (5m) vs 50% (4m), Mirage 73% (11m) vs 43% (7m), Inferno 67% (6m) vs 0m, Ancient 55% (11m) vs 25% (4m).
day3_deciders.floor_status: PRIMARY CONTRARIAN-BUT-NOT-STUPID PICK: Passes BOTH the 30% and 35% underdog floors in both the 04:59Z canonical (39.23%) and 07:34Z 3-book (37.38%) captures while HotSpawn crowd ownership sits at just 14%-17% (2.27x-2.80x leverage).

flags.resolution: Updated `scripts/94b3d48a/build.py` to preserve the verified 17-match Oct 15 snapshot when new fixtures lack dated Oct 15 metadata, and updated `unresolved-7177d07f.yml` to push to `main` / `${{ github.ref_name }}`.

flags.finding: When `pages.yml` re-evaluates `scripts/c64a5e19/build.py` at wall-clock time after fixtures lock (e.g., `1079586` and `1080285` locking at 07:54 UTC), `build_recheck()` sees fewer open fixtures than the committed `04:59Z` snapshot.
